content.title: About
content.content: Shrimp Garden Salad is a light dish made of shrimp, fresh lettuce, boiled eggs and a variety of vegetables (excluding tomato and carrot). It is served without dressing, allowing the natural flavors of the ingredients to shine.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Shrimp are high‑protein and low‑calorie, making them a great choice for diet‑friendly meals.
The lettuce mix often includes romaine, arugula and spinach, which are rich in vitamins A, C and K.
Eggs add not only taste but also valuable nutrients such as choline and vitamin D.
Skipping dressing lets you control the amount of salt and fat in the dish.
The salad can be easily customized, for example by adding avocado or nuts.

items.title: Rich source of protein
items.content: Shrimp and eggs provide high‑quality protein essential for tissue repair and muscle maintenance.

items.title: Low in calories
items.content: A dressing‑free salad is low in calories, helping with weight management.

items.title: Vitamins and minerals
items.content: Leafy greens supply vitamins A, C, K and folate, while shrimp contribute zinc and selenium.

items.title: Omega‑3 fatty acids
items.content: Shrimp contain modest amounts of omega‑3s, beneficial for cardiovascular health.

items.title: Immune support
items.content: Vitamin D from eggs and zinc from shrimp help strengthen the immune system.

items.title: Shellfish allergy
items.content: Shrimp are a common allergen; individuals with shellfish allergy should avoid this dish.

items.title: Cholesterol content
items.content: Eggs and shrimp contain cholesterol; people with high cholesterol should consume them in moderation.

items.title: Bacterial contamination
items.content: Raw or undercooked shrimp can cause foodborne illness; always use fresh, properly cooked seafood.

items.title: Sodium levels
items.content: If shrimp are pre‑marinated, they may contain added salt.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the salad chilled, immediately after preparation. It can be enjoyed as a standalone meal or as a side dish. For extra flavor, a light squeeze of lemon or a drizzle of olive oil may be added.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the prepared salad in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours. Store shrimp and eggs separately from the leafy greens to maintain crunchiness.
